hypothesis: The exact v51 SP500/SPCX live-v3 route may retain an attributable after-cost edge when its backend and source-native observer decisions remain identical and complete lifecycles occur on both configured sides.
decision: Continue the exact v51 SP500/SPCX route unchanged. The recovered live process now has 4/4 source-native observer decisions matching the executable backend with zero mismatches. All four decisions were ineligible, so economic and long-side evidence remain unchanged from revision 4.

findings.interpretation: The recovered backend and independent observers agree on two consecutive completed 15-minute boundaries for each symbol. This extends transport continuity but is not a new profitability sample. The prior resolved SPCX short, still-open SP500 and SPCX shorts, and absence of attributable long lifecycles remain the economic evidence boundary.

limitations: Four matched decisions are insufficient to estimate mismatch probability.
No recovered-run decision was eligible, so this revision adds no entry, fill, exit, or PnL evidence.
The prior process supplied the only eligible v51 index signals and both were short.
SPCX remains a one-trade winner and is entirely largest-winner dependent.
SP500 and the second SPCX short remain open and their marked results are provisional.
The observer and backend can share the same upstream public-data defect.
Archive and live-v3 source identities remain non-interchangeable.
falsifier: Reject recovered-run transport parity if any later common completed boundary differs, any eligible observer signal lacks an attributable backend action or explicit position/router non-action, source coverage becomes incomplete, or run/profile/provider identity changes. Update economic confidence only with resolved, attributable long and short lifecycles after exact fees, funding, slippage, latency, stop behavior, exit attribution, and largest-winner sensitivity.

recommendation.Recommendation: Keep the exact v51 index route and 100/40/80 completed-bar profit-lock unchanged while collecting the first attributable long lifecycle and resolving both open index shorts.
recommendation.Why now: Two consecutive recovered boundaries preserve decision transport, while the unresolved question remains side-separated economics rather than signal delivery.
recommendation.Evidence reviewed: Immutable recovered-run 4/4 decision parity, prior 76/76 process-run parity, one resolved SPCX short, protected open SP500 and SPCX shorts, and exact v51 identity.
recommendation.Observed problem or opportunity: No eligible long onset has occurred in attributable v51 execution; the recovered process has added no eligible signal yet.
recommendation.Applicable market regime: Source-native completed-15m fresh breakout-pressure onsets with causal top-ten pressure age at or below 15 seconds.
recommendation.Alternatives considered: Retune thresholds for more signals, pool pre-v51 observer signals, infer edge from one winner, or continue the frozen source-native trial.
recommendation.Expected upside: Preserves an aligned live route while collecting unbiased long/short lifecycle evidence.
recommendation.Main risks and failure modes: Sparse and one-sided outcomes, shared upstream defects, right censoring, completed-bar exit gap risk, execution drag, and false confidence from one winner.
recommendation.Validation completed: Recovered-run identity binding, exact compatible-ledger suffix verification, 4/4 decision parity, authority-none observer contracts, and protected open-index lifecycle attribution.
recommendation.Validation still required: At least one resolved attributable long lifecycle, resolution of both open index shorts, more short outcomes, actual-minus-stress residuals, largest-winner sensitivity, and shared-portfolio interaction evidence.
recommendation.Success metrics: No unexplained eligible-without-action event; complete protection and flat/order reconciliation; positive side-separated after-cost economics; positive net excluding the largest winner when sample size permits; bounded execution residuals.
recommendation.Failure / rollback triggers: Any decision mismatch, unprotected exposure, orphan order, stale/conflicting attribution, repeated execution drag beyond stress, exit-branch mismatch, or a compatible predeclared sample with adverse after-cost expectancy.
recommendation.Confidence level: High confidence for two recovered common boundaries; low confidence in economic edge and long-side behavior.

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Capture and resolve the first attributable v51 long lifecycle for SPCX while resolving the open SP500 and SPCX shorts under the frozen v51 exit contract.
